status: provisional constants; not calibrated on real papers. Justification: same deposited data, so reconstruction should match to rounding; quarter-SE and one-SE bands follow common reporting of trivial and material shifts and were set before fitting. Synthetic tests only.
n_branch: A dataset's scoring sample is the origin level if its N equals the sealed published N. If not, the first listed alternative with an equal N is used and marked n_branch_selected. If none equals it, origin is used and the claims are marked n_unmatched. No coefficient is consulted.
implementer_agreement: All three within tolerance: use median. Exactly one agreeing pair: use the pair mean and send the third to code audit. No pair: indeterminate implementer_disagreement.
rounding: A printed value with d decimals stands for the interval value +/- 0.5 x 10^-d. Distances are measured to the interval.

magnitude.unit: published SE. Printed SE where available. For t tests and contrasts the SE is derived as |printed mean difference| / |printed t| and flagged derived, a declared adaptation.

multi_df_F.unit: absolute F; not an SE-unit check

magnitude.tables: Printed-precision share reported; never an SE-unit check

inference.rule: Band of the published p from its rounding interval or inequality. Same band or a stronger band for a positive significance claim passes. An adjacent band on the same side of alpha passes with a note. An adjacent band crossing alpha is grey. Two or more bands, or a newly significant reconstruction two bands from a printed non-significant result, is out. Indirect effects: 95 percent interval excludes or includes zero as printed, plus delta p band reported separately.

benchmark_inference.linear: HC3 at the participant, the assignment unit, in place of clustering because assignment is individual. Declared adaptation. On the paired differences in dataset 1. Few-cluster threshold not applicable: no clusters.
benchmark_inference.logit_dataset4: No assignment, so no clusters invented: benchmark inference not audited. Sandwich HC0 reported as uncertain.
benchmark_inference.mediation: Native bootstrap; benchmark inference not audited.

stability_rule: Across origin and equivalent levels with distinct realized values: same sign and same side of alpha (or same zero-exclusion). Failing gives fragile. No distinct equivalent gives fragility_not_assessed, never robustness.
fragile_inference: Origin passes, native p<.05 and benchmark p>=.05.
discrepant: Agreeing implementations out of tolerance at origin and at every equivalent reading on sign, two-or-more-band inference or magnitude. Reported as discrepant_candidate until adversarial review and real human confirmation. Never final without both.
missingness: Failed or missing estimate: indeterminate incomplete_coverage. Missing published SE: magnitude not audited, then the claim needs sign and inference only and carries the code magnitude_not_audited.
label_sensitivity: Each claim is rescored with uncertain levels treated as equivalent. If the outcome changes the claim is flagged label_sensitive and both scores are preserved for a human-sourced decision.
focal_set: Claims both readers marked focal: Study 1 three paired tests; Study 2 three t tests and nine indirect effects (benevolence, value alignment, relational concerns on three outcomes); Study 3 six contrasts; Study 4 Model 1. Reader-disputed tiers are uncertain and non-focal. The one-reader focal mark on the Study 4 overview table is reported as a sensitivity.

families.H1: loyalty raises support: P1, T2, C3.H1, L4.M1
families.H3: divisive history lowers support among loyal: C3.H3

paper_aggregation.family_rule: All claims consistent: consistent. At least half discrepant_candidate: discrepant_candidate. Otherwise any indeterminate or a sub-half discrepant_candidate: indeterminate. Otherwise any fragile: fragile. Otherwise fragile_inference.
paper_aggregation.paper_rule: All families consistent: consistent. Any family discrepant_candidate: indeterminate pending adversarial review and human confirmation. Any family indeterminate: indeterminate. Otherwise any fragile: fragile, then fragile_inference.
paper_aggregation.justification: The article argues by hypothesis across studies and outcomes. A family is the unit the article supports, so one departing cell does not decide it, yet a family with half its tests failing cannot stand.

comparability_map.fully_reproduced: focal consistent and no tier discrepant
comparability_map.partially_reproduced: focal fragile, or focal consistent with discrepant lower tier
